title: LearnPress Course Wishlist Add-on before 4.1.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows…
description: LearnPress Course Wishlist Add-on versions before 4.1.2 have an insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability. This flaw allows remote attackers to manipulate any user's course wishlist by supplying an arbitrary user_id parameter to a REST API endpoint instead of relying on session identity. The vulnerability affects the publicly accessible load_content_via_ajax REST route, which requires only a public wp_rest nonce. Attackers can add or remove courses from any user's wishlist and check if a course is wishlisted by iterating user_id and course_id values.
